newsitem.title: BOLIVIA: Bolivia CPI down 0.07 pct in October.
newsitem.headline: Bolivia CPI down 0.07 pct in October.

text.p: Bolivia's consumer prices dropped 0.07 percent in October, down from a 1.88 percent rise in October 1995 and a 0.16 percent increase in September.
The National Institute of Statistics said prices fell partly due to a high agricultural products output that helped keep prices at bay.

Cumulative consumer inflation in the first 10 months of the year was 7.22 percent against 8.65 percent in the same period of 1995. In the 12 months to October prices rose 11.1 percent, up from 10.61 percent in the previous 12 months.
